prompt: valgrind cachegrind fsave large FPU instruction simulated access size
answer: Cachegrind treats x86/amd64 FPU instructions with data sizes of 28 or 108 bytes—such as `fsave`—as if they access only 16 bytes. This may reduce accuracy, although these instructions are described as rare.
